New 2027 Hyundai Creta Leaked Inside Out in Latest Spy Video

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Carblogindia.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Carblogindia.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights

  • The famed mid-size SUV is about to receive a new-generation avatar, which will be larger than the existing model.
  • We have seen this trend with the new Kia Seltos.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Carblogindia.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

Updated on 10.11.2026 – The next-gen Hyundai Creta was recently spied by mrd_vlogs on Instagram alongside the Mahindra Thar OG. The famed mid-size SUV is about to receive a new-generation avatar, which will be larger than the existing model. We have seen this trend with the new Kia Seltos. This also points to the fact that the new Creta will be even more feature-laden than the current model. The visuals capture the camouflaged exterior of the SUV. Even though the exact details are concealed, we can figure out that the design elements will be fresh. Also, the size of the SUV will most likely be larger than the present model.

📌 The Core Development

However, a sneak peek into the cabin reveals a few key details. This includes things like a dual-screen setup, premium upholstery, Boss Mode to control the passenger seat movement from the rear, rear AC vents, dual-tone interior theme, etc. We know that the Korean auto giant loves to equip its models with tons of new-age amenities and the new Creta won’t be any different. Finally, the powertrain and transmission options will most likely be carried forward as well. More details will emerge in the coming weeks.

Updated on 08.09.2026 – The upcoming new iteration of the famed Hyundai Creta has been spied testing on Indian roads for a while now. The mid-size SUV is slated to come with a slew of upgrades, including exterior styling, the cabin and new-age tech and convenience amenities. That has been Hyundai’s strong suit for the longest time. The sheer connected functionalities is what sets it apart from the tough rivals. In fact, some reports even suggest that it might get a hybrid engine this time around. We will have to wait to know the exact details about that.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

In any case, the latest spy video by gearshift.garaze on Instagram captures the camouflaged SUV on the road. We are able to get a relatively clear glimpse of the new 19-inch dual-tone aero alloy wheels we typically see on electric cars. Apart from that, some other bits include new styling, new LED lighting and grille, an updated interior, including the digital cockpit, a new infotainment display, a spacious cabin and much more. Stay tuned for more information in the coming days.

Originally published on 05.05.2026 – The new Hyundai Creta has been spotted testing in international markets, including the U.S. and Korea. Creta is the most successful mid-size SUV in India. It has held that spot for years now despite increasing competition. In fact, its demand is still at an all-time high, courtesy of its all-around nature. This includes things like new styling, loads of tech and convenience amenities, active and passive safety prowess and availability of multiple powertrain and transmission options. Interestingly, it is about to get even more enticing.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

The latest spy images of the new Hyundai Creta have surfaced from California, U.S. These capture a rather modern cabin with a different layout in comparison to the current-gen model. The new Creta will carry a colossal central touchscreen infotainment display, which will contain most in-car functions. As a consequence, the digital instrument cluster will shrink in size significantly. It will just carry the absolutely critical information for the driver. Apart from that, the overall cabin will feel premium due to the usage of soft-touch materials. However, the biggest update has to be the new Pleos Connect infotainment system, integrating various aspects. It will make the new Creta a Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV). It is also seen that the steering column will now host the gear lever, freeing up acres of space. Needless to mention, the active safety features will be even sharper with Level 2+ ADAS.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

On the outside, the new Hyundai Creta is expected to grow in size. We have recently seen something similar with the new Kia Seltos. It will ensure that the road presence of the new Creta will be greatly enhanced. The other new elements will include a pixel-style lighting setup and the new 4-dot logo. Even the fascia will incorporate new components like the headlamps, DRLs and bumper. On the sides, we might witness new 19-inch alloy wheels, while the tail section will also be redesigned. Overall, the appearance of the new Creta will certainly be one of its key defining factors.

The new Hyundai Creta, in the international markets, will come with a hybrid powertrain, something many carmakers are moving towards. In addition, there will be the familiar petrol and diesel mills with manual and automatic transmission alternatives. It remains to be seen whether the Indian-spec model will offer the option of the hybrid mill since it will be more expensive than the regular versions. In any case, more details will surface in the coming months.
